test: fix integration tests broken after API convention changes

PR นี้แก้ integration test (`make test-integration`) ที่ compile ไม่ผ่านบน `integrate/v1` มาตั้งแต่ #27 ตอนนี้รันได้แล้วและผ่านหมด แก้แค่ไฟล์เทสต์ 2 ไฟล์ โค้ดจริงไม่ได้แตะเลย

ที่หลุดมาได้เพราะไฟล์พวกนี้มี build tag `integration` เวลารัน `go test ./...` ปกติมันเลยไม่ถูก compile ตอนเราเปลี่ยนโค้ด stock / stock-log กันใน PR ก่อนๆ เลยไม่มีใครเห็น

สิ่งที่แก้
- `stock_log_test.go` ยังส่ง `LowStock: true` / `Page: 2` อยู่ แต่ตอน #26 ผมเปลี่ยน field พวกนี้เป็น string ไปแล้ว เลยแก้เป็น `"true"` กับ `strconv.Itoa(n)`
- `stock_test.go` ยังเรียก `GetStockContainersByStockID(ctx, "admin", "", ...)` แบบเก่า หลัง #25 ต้องส่ง `&currentuser.CurrentUser{...}` แทน
- `slApp` ใน `stock_log_test.go` ยังใช้ `c.Locals("role")` เทสต์ HTTP เลยได้ 401 หมด 15 ตัว แล้วยังส่ง `stockId` / `pageSize` ที่ server ไม่รู้จักแล้วด้วย อันนี้ผมทำพังเองตอน #26 แก้ให้ใช้ `currentuser.Set` กับชื่อแบบ snake_case แล้ว
- เทสต์เพิ่ม movement 2 ตัวตัดของออกโดยไม่ได้รับของเข้าก่อน ระบบเลยไม่ให้ตัดเพราะสต็อกไม่พอ (ซึ่งถูกแล้ว) อันนี้ฟิล์มแก้ไว้ใน #30 แล้ว ผมเลย cherry-pick `05908fc` มาใช้เลย ชื่อคนเขียนยังเป็นฟิล์มเหมือนเดิม

ผลเทสต์
```
$ go build ./... && go vet ./... && go vet -tags integration ./test/integration/   # ผ่าน
$ go test -count=1 ./...
ok  	backend/internal/stock
ok  	backend/internal/stock-log
ok  	backend/package
$ go test -tags integration -count=1 -v ./test/integration/
PASS: 68  FAIL: 0
ok  	backend/test/integration
```
ก่อนแก้คือ compile ไม่ผ่านเลยสักตัว

หลังจากนี้ผมจะทำต่อตามนี้
1. ฟิล์มรีวิว PR นี้แล้ว merge เข้า `integrate/v1`
2. ผมดึง `integrate/v1` ล่าสุดเข้า `be/feature/course` (#30) แล้ว `gofmt` ไฟล์ `course/dto.go` จากนั้น push เข้า branch ของฟิล์ม (commit `05908fc` ที่ซ้ำกัน git รวมให้เองไม่ชน)
3. รัน server หนึ่งรอบให้ DB สร้าง index ของคอร์ส แล้วรัน `make test-integration` ให้ผ่านหมด
4. ผมรีวิว #30 แล้ว merge
5. หลังจากนั้นผมจะแตก branch ใหม่จาก `integrate/v1` ไปทำหน้าเว็บต่อ

อีกเรื่อง ต่อไปก่อนเปิด PR เรารัน `make test-integration` กันด้วยนะ จะได้ไม่หลุดแบบนี้อีก

Align the casts in a trigger WHEN expression before comparing

`pg_get_triggerdef` adds casts to a trigger's `WHEN` expression, such as `0::numeric` or `'done'::status`. A hand-written definition leaves them out. The CHECK, policy, index and view comparisons drop such casts with `alignCurrentCasts`, but the trigger comparison only ran `normalizeCheckExpr`, so `plan` reported `CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER` on every run:

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER orders_amount AFTER UPDATE ON public.orders
    FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.amount > 0) EXECUTE FUNCTION public.stamp();
```

`equalTriggerDef` now aligns the current side's `WHEN` casts with the desired side's. A cast is dropped only where the desired side has none, so a changed constant still reads as a change.

## Tests

- `testdata/plan/trigger_when_cast_no_diff.yml`: numeric and enum comparisons plan clean (failed before the fix).
- `testdata/plan/trigger_when_cast_change.yml`: `> 0` changed to `> 1` is still reported.

 ## [Unreleased]
 
+* `plan` no longer reports a change on every run for a trigger whose `WHEN` expression is written without the casts PostgreSQL adds, such as `WHEN (NEW.amount > 0)` on a `numeric` column or `WHEN (NEW.status = 'done')` on an enum column.

--- a/LIMITATIONS.md

@@ -614,6 +614,33 @@ in the desired file.
 
 Origin: constraint trigger FROM review, 2026-10-31.
 
+## A cast removed from a CHECK or trigger WHEN expression is not detected
+
+The catalog adds casts to a `CHECK` body and to a trigger `WHEN` expression,
+such as `0::numeric` or `'done'::status`, that a hand-written definition
+leaves out. So a cast that only the current side has is dropped before the
+comparison. A cast the user removes is dropped the same way, even where it
+changes the result:
+
+```sql
+-- database
+CREATE TRIGGER t AFTER UPDATE ON o FOR EACH ROW
+    WHEN (NEW.amount::integer > 0) EXECUTE FUNCTION f();
+-- desired
+CREATE TRIGGER t AFTER UPDATE ON o FOR EACH ROW
+    WHEN (NEW.amount > 0) EXECUTE FUNCTION f();
+```
+
+The plan reports no changes, although `amount = 0.4` fails the first condition
+and passes the second. A cast that is added, or changed to another type, is
+still reported. Telling the added casts from a written one needs the type of
+the expression under the cast, as for a `DEFAULT`.
+
+Workaround: change something else in the expression along with the cast, or
+drop and create the object by hand.
+
+Origin: trigger WHEN cast review, 2026-10-31.
+
 ## Perpetual drift on a schema-qualified sequence in a column DEFAULT
 
 Priority: low.

benchmarks.task_description:
Keep panel resizing responsive in long conversations

Aucune issue associée.

## Résumé

- Redimensionner le panneau latéral regroupe les mouvements de souris avant de recalculer la conversation, au lieu de recalculer pour chaque événement.
- Les paragraphes hors écran conservent une hauteur exacte sans reconstruire leurs éléments graphiques ; leur dessin est mis à jour lorsqu’ils redeviennent visibles.
- Le dernier message reste visible après un changement de largeur lorsque la conversation suivait déjà sa fin.

## Captures d'écran

Même conversation de test, panneau ouvert à la même largeur : avant, le changement de largeur remontait vers le message 117 ; après, il conserve le dernier message 159.

| Avant | Après |
| ----- | ----- |
| ![Panneau avant](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b23250d9-a7a8-4e10-bc5f-803a233a5e3a) | ![Panneau après](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/58da8e6a-dcc1-482f-979d-ba8fa231409e) |

Vérification supplémentaire : réponse à une question après 50 changements de focus, puis dépôt réel d’un fichier texte et d’une image dans le composeur, avec contrôle de concurrence activé.

![Question et pièces jointes](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ea89f07e-da2b-41c1-adb5-e3d2733c513f)

## Détails techniques

- `toolPanel.resizePending` est consommé par la boucle de rendu existante ; `DragEnd` applique la dernière largeur avant l’enregistrement.
- `transcriptLayout.measure` active une mesure sans dessin pour les textes des lignes cachées. `flowText.paintedWidth` permet de reconstruire ensuite les objets et la géométrie de sélection à la bonne largeur. Aucun changement de bibliothèque ni refactorisation générale.
- Audit de la bibliothèque Fyne embarquée et de ses callbacks : ils s’exécutent déjà dans la boucle UI. Un callback direct ne prouve pas une course ; c’est également le fonctionnement décrit par la [documentation Fyne](https://docs.fyne.io/started/goroutines/).
- Mesure native Linux/X11 dans Docker Debian 13, 2 CPU et 4 Gio, conversation synthétique de 320 messages : 30 allers-retours rapides de poignée provoquaient un pic de 849 ms avant, contre 71,8 ms sur le dernier essai après. C’est une mesure de ce scénario, pas une garantie de cadence sur toutes les machines. À 3 200 messages, des passages de 131–160 ms restent observables : le recalcul des hauteurs demeure proportionnel à la conversation.
- Exécutés : `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, builds Linux X11 et Wayland ; build Windows natif sur la combinaison des deux changements demandés. Tests temporaires de comparaison de hauteur, liens et sélection avant/après mesure cachée, y compris sous `-race` ; essais graphiques natifs, défilement vers des messages précédemment cachés, dépôts Xdnd texte/image et question après 50 cycles de focus, sans rapport de concurrence.
- Limites : les crashs signalés au dépôt de fichier/changement de fenêtre n’ont pas été reproduits. Cette PR corrige les blocages et le saut de défilement démontrés ; elle ne prétend pas avoir corrigé une cause de crash inconnue. Pas de test graphique Windows, Wayland ou NixOS en conditions réelles.

Fill in the schema of a constraint trigger's FROM table

`pg_get_triggerdef` writes the `FROM` table of a constraint trigger without its schema once that schema is on the search_path. `parseTriggerDef` filled in the schema of the trigger's own relation, but not of `Constrrel`, so a desired definition such as

```sql
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER events_check AFTER INSERT ON public.events FROM public.accounts
    DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.chk();
```

read as a change. A constraint trigger has no `OR REPLACE`, so `plan` emitted `DROP TRIGGER` and `CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER` on every run (or a skipped `DROP TRIGGER` under the default drop policy).

`parseTriggerDef` now fills in an implicit `FROM` schema the same way it does for the relation.

## Tests

- `testdata/plan/constraint_trigger_from_no_diff.yml` (failed before the fix).

diff --git a/LIMITATIONS.md b/LIMITATIONS.md
index 5dec30ef..45fa8d17 100644
--- a/LIMITATIONS.md
+++ b/LIMITATIONS.md
@@ -583,6 +583,37 @@ type of the expression under the cast. Only the database knows that type.
 
 Origin: default cast review, 2026-09-24.
 
+## A bare FROM table of a constraint trigger is read in the trigger's schema
+
+Priority: low.
+
+A constraint trigger's `FROM` table written without its schema is read in the
+trigger's schema. On the catalog side this happens only when the trigger's
+table is written bare too, which says its schema is on the search_path.
+PostgreSQL resolves a bare name through the whole search_path, so the two
+differ when the search_path holds more than one schema and the `FROM` table is
+in another of them:
+
+```sql
+-- pista plan -n app,public --search-path app,public
+-- database: app.events, public.accounts, no app.accounts
+CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER c AFTER INSERT ON app.events FROM public.accounts
+    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION chk();
+```
+
+The catalog writes `ON events FROM accounts`, and `accounts` is read as
+`app.accounts`. So a desired `FROM public.accounts` reads as a change on every
+plan, and a move to a new `app.accounts` goes unreported. A desired bare

fix: wire shared Caddy for native-only Agent lifecycle

继续补齐 #1128 的原生节点接管闭环：#1137 已允许已审核的 shared-caddy 原生生命周期权限，但 Agent 启动接线仍排除了 native-only/landing-only 节点，导致这类节点没有共享网站运行时。

移除这个排除条件，为无 Gateway 的 Linux/root Agent 延迟配置已有的原生 Caddy adapter。Docker 不存在时只使用已审核网站包内的固定 Caddy；不安装 Docker、不启用 Gateway/Tunnel，不在启动时创建网站或重放应用任务。具体服务仍由显式授权的安装/升级触发。

Refs #1128。Linux amd64 命令编译与差异检查通过，无新增依赖、测试框架或环境。必需 CI 待此 PR 实际运行；原生节点旧网站尚未替换，不提前声称验收完成。

test(e2e): wait for the popup to navigate before reading its url

Closes #3123

The modified-click test read `popup.url()` the moment the popup event fired. A popup is `about:blank` until its first navigation commits, so a loaded CI runner failed with `Received string: about:blank`. It now awaits `popup.waitForURL(...)` before asserting.

Test-only change; no README impact. Fixes the three tests with this race: `in-place-dialogs`, `issue-dialog-closing-pr` and `profile-links`. Verified with `./tests/run-local.sh` over the three files, `--repeat-each=5`: 330 passed (the original test alone, `--repeat-each=20`: 20 passed). Reported by forge-board-cloud-api, whose copy is identical.

Layers: e2e only, since the fault is in the e2e test itself.

Report a bare enum type name in the no-enum-type lint rule

`no-enum-type` in `rules/gitlab/types.yml` asserted `!(column.base_type in doc.enums)`. `doc.enums` is keyed by the schema-qualified name (`public.mood`), but `base_type` is the type as written. A column typed `mood` was therefore never reported. `pista dump` writes an enum on the search_path without its schema (`status status NOT NULL`), so the rule did not fire on a dumped schema at all. `TestGitLabRules` passed only because it wrote `public.mood`.

The rule now also matches an enum by its name. A bare name that matches an enum in any schema is reported. That can be wider than the search_path would resolve, but a schema with the same enum name in two schemas is rare, and a lint rule that reports one more column does no harm.

## Tests

- `TestGitLabRulesBareEnumName`: `mood` and `mood[]` are reported, `smallint` is not (failed before the fix).

---

fix: 차원 전환 시험의 제공자 차단 가정 수정

## 요약

#227에서 알려진 기존 실패로 분리한 `TestEmbeddingDimensionMigrationIntegration`을 수정합니다.

- 원인: 시험은 429 표본을 처리한 같은 Worker가 바로 400 표본도 처리한다고 가정했습니다. [제공자 장애 중 작업 확보 차단](https://github.com/Alpha-gone/agent-context-sharing/blob/fix/embedding-dimension-worker-block/spec/service/agent-context/sdd/indexing.md#제공자-장애-중-작업-확보-차단) 계약(`3f75e89`)은 429를 관측한 Worker의 새 작업 확보를 탐침 시각까지 중단하므로, 두 번째 회차의 `processed=false`는 정상 동작입니다.
- 수정: 차단 상태는 계약상 Worker 메모리에 있으므로 장애 표본마다 같은 구성의 새 Worker로 처리합니다. 시도 횟수·pending/failed 상태·비밀 비노출 검증과 768차원 재색인·검색·복귀 흐름은 유지합니다.
- 구현·SQL·스키마·SDD·DOX는 변경하지 않았습니다. 차단 자체의 동작은 색인 패키지의 기존 회로 시험이 담당합니다.
- [후속 검토 기록](https://github.com/Alpha-gone/agent-context-sharing/blob/fix/embedding-dimension-worker-block/spec/service/agent-context/reviews/2026-10-31-issue-162-embedding-dimension.md)과 요청 기록을 추가했습니다. 원래 #162 검토의 당시 기록은 보존합니다.

## 검증

- 고정 이미지 `sha256:2b6d5104…c697`(PostgreSQL 18.6)의 전용 합성 컨테이너를 사용했습니다.
- 수정 전: `provider_blocked provider_status=429 retry_after_seconds=44` 직후 `configuration_test.go:305: 장애의 작업 처리: <nil>` 실패를 재현했습니다.
- 수정 후: `TEST_DATABASE_REQUIRED=1 go test -race -p 1 -json ./internal/migrate -count=1 -timeout=15m`에서 84건이 실패·건너뜀 없이 통과했습니다. #227의 83건 통과·1건 실패와 같은 시험 집합입니다.
- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `git diff --check`와 변경 문서의 링크·앵커를 확인했습니다.
- 시험 DB 잔류가 없음을 확인한 뒤 소유 컨테이너만 정리했습니다.

+- 기준: `dev`의 `a3e17c5`, 브랜치 `fix/embedding-dimension-worker-block`.
+
+## 원인과 변경
+
+시험은 429 표본을 처리한 같은 Worker로 400 표본을 즉시 처리한다고 기대했다. [제공자 장애 중 작업 확보 차단](../sdd/indexing.md#제공자-장애-중-작업-확보-차단) 계약은 429를 관측한 Worker의 새 작업 확보를 지터가 적용된 탐침 시각까지 중단한다. 따라서 400 회차가 `processed=false`를 반환한 것은 구현 결함이 아니다. 이 계약을 도입한 `3f75e89` 이후 시험 fixture가 갱신되지 않은 것이 원인이다.
+
+차단 상태는 계약상 Worker 메모리에 있으므로 장애 표본마다 같은 구성의 새 Worker를 만들어 처리한다. 각 표본의 시도 횟수·pending/failed 상태·비밀 비노출 검증과 768차원 재색인·검색·복귀 흐름은 유지한다. 차단 자체의 확보 중단·탐침·회복은 색인 패키지의 기존 회로 시험이 담당한다. 구현·SQL·스키마·SDD는 변경하지 않았으며 DOX pass에서 소유권·경로 변경이 없어 기존 DOX를 유지했다.
+
+## 재현과 검증
+
+- Go 1.27.1과 고정 PostgreSQL/AGE 이미지 `sha256:2b6d51048c03dae147064683f5b078690f1525365d561fd80b78f74de8c3c697`(PostgreSQL 18.6)의 전용 합성 컨테이너를 사용했다. 기존 개발·다른 시험 DB는 사용하지 않았다.
+- 수정 전 단일 시험에서 `provider_blocked provider_status=429 retry_after_seconds=44` 기록 직후 `configuration_test.go:305: 장애의 작업 처리: <nil>` 실패를 재현했다.
+- 수정 후 `TEST_DATABASE_REQUIRED=1 go test -race -p 1 -json ./internal/migrate -count=1 -timeout=15m`에서 84건이 실패·건너뜀 없이 통과했다. PR #227의 83건 통과·1건 실패와 같은 시험 집합이다.
+- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `git diff --check`와 변경 문서의 로컬 링크·앵커를 확인했다.
+- 시험 종료 후 소유 컨테이너만 정리했으며 기존 개발·다른 시험 자원과 개인 IDE 파일은 유지했다.

benchmarks.task_description:
fix(agent): the speaker's log no longer fills up with certificate refusals from other devices on the network, such as Amazon Echo speakers

Refusals of the marge-tls certificate from LAN peers (Amazon Echos and similar probing port 443) were logged at WARN and written to the NAND log, about 150 a day on one reporter ST20 (#841). The firmware reaches marge-tls via 127.0.0.1, so only loopback refusals carry the #419 clock / stale-CA evidence; those stay at WARN. Foreign-peer refusals go to DEBUG. An unparseable peer counts as the box, so no evidence is lost on a format change.

Field check across the local bundles (2026-08 to 2026-10): 1221 of 1237 refusals came from foreign peers, 16 from loopback.

Tests: new cases for IPv4/IPv6 foreign peers and the unparseable fallback.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Name the default database in the Connected to comment

With no dbname in the connection string and no `PGDATABASE`, pgx leaves `cfg.Database` empty and the server connects to the database named after the user. `ConnInfoComment` printed the empty name:

```
pista dump -c "host=localhost port=5415 user=postgres"
-- Connected to postgres://postgres@localhost:5415/
```

and `dbname= user=postgres` on a socket. The comment now falls back to the user name, the database PostgreSQL actually uses.

## Tests

- `TestConnInfoComment_DefaultDBName`: TCP and socket forms (failed before the fix).
